- **[high, security] `command_template` and `argv` persisted raw** — Introduced `_sanitize_text()` (no length cap) and `_sanitize_argv()` helpers that apply the same `_SECRET_PATTERNS` scrubber already used for `stdout_tail`/`stderr_tail`. `_attempted_step_payload`, `_denied_step_payload`, and `_skipped_human_payload` now pipe `outcome.command` through `_sanitize_text` and `outcome.argv` through `_sanitize_argv` (which scrubs each element independently). `reason` is also scrubbed in case a leaky head from a manifest ever lands in a runner-formatted reason string.
